headline.interaction_familywise_method: Holm step-down over 12 model-assisted CR2 source-conversation-cluster-robust two-sided t tests with Satterthwaite degrees of freedom
headline.interaction_inference: Holm's procedure rejects none of 12 source-cluster-robust CR2/Satterthwaite hypotheses at familywise alpha 0.05, so this corrective exploratory rerun detects no deployed-tier by compression interaction in the tested family. The pointwise clustered 95% intervals are descriptive (0 exclude zero); the largest absolute pointwise interval endpoint is 12.9 percentage points; it is not a pre-specified resolution or equivalence bound. The unadjusted CR2/Satterthwaite tests have 0 of 12 p-values below 0.05. The conditional cluster-sign-symmetry sensitivity calculation has 0 below 0.05. No equivalence margin or equivalence test was pre-registered, so this does not establish independence.
